# Dominican Hair Salon by Berquis

> Dominican hair salon based in Round Rock, Texas. Smooth, full of body and frizz-free, without overdoing the heat. Blowouts, layered cuts, natural curls and color from a Dominican stylist with 25+ years behind the chair, in her suite inside Salons by JC in Round Rock.

## Services
- Dominican blowout: The signature: wash, treatment and a smooth, bouncy blow-dry with body and movement, frizz-free without overusing heat.
- Layered cuts: Clean, crisp layers and trims, with a close look at your ends before the scissors come out.
- Natural curls: A curly-friendly chair: cuts and styling that respect your pattern, with tips to keep it hydrated at home.
- Roller sets: The classic Dominican roller set for smooth, voluminous hair, often paired with deep conditioning.
- Color & highlights: Foil highlights, balayage, all-over color and bold fashion shades like teal, finished with a blowout.
- Treatments: Deep conditioning, Olaplex bond care and Brazilian Blowout smoothing to bring dry, frizzy or damaged hair back to life.

## About
Dominican Hair Salon by Berquis is a one-stylist suite inside Salons by JC on the I-35 frontage road in Round Rock. The Dominican flag hangs over her mirror, the shelves are lined with treatments, Olaplex and Brazilian Blowout, and every appointment is one-on-one with Berquis. In her own words, she has over 25 years of experience as a hair stylist, and one longtime client says she has been doing hair since she was about 14. Clients describe her as kind, patient and a great listener: she puts on her glasses, studies your strands and ends, and tells you what your hair needs before she starts. Her specialty is the Dominican blowout and straightening natural hair without chemicals, alongside layered cuts, roller sets, deep conditioning, highlights and natural curl care. People drive in from all over, some bring their daughters and mothers, and more than one says it reminds them of home in New York. Bienvenidos.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is a Dominican blowout?
  A: A wash and deep conditioning, a roller set or round-brush blow-dry, and a smooth finish that leaves hair straight, full of body and frizz-free, without chemicals.
- Q: Do you work with natural and curly hair?
  A: Yes. Berquis straightens natural hair without chemicals and also cuts and styles curls while respecting your natural pattern, including 3B and curlier textures.
- Q: Do you do Brazilian Blowouts?
  A: Yes. A Brazilian Blowout smooths frizz while keeping your curl, and Berquis will tell you honestly whether it or a Dominican blowout suits your hair better.
- Q: How long does an appointment take?
  A: It depends on the service. A blowout is quicker; a deep conditioning treatment, roller set, blow-dry and style can take a few hours. Call and Berquis will tell you what to expect.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Yes, please call or text ahead. It is a one-chair suite, so booking in advance guarantees your time with Berquis.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Friday 11 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 2 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday. Holiday hours can differ, so call to check.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 3021 I-35, Suite 13, Round Rock, TX 78664, inside Salons by JC. Parking is on site.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Call or text (646) 457-5752, or send a request through the booking form on this site.
